programme.title: Eco Africa
programme.desc: Eco Africa highlights the innovative and inspiring projects from across Africa and Europe that are being put into practice in a a bid to tackle climate change and support our depleting environments. In Africa especially, huge numbers of animal and wildlife species have dramatically fallen, largely due to a vast increase in human population across the continent. The increasing population is taking over vast swathes of natural land and in turn, adding to the demand for natural resources. This series explores the different concepts being used to help sustain our future, such as alternative resources, biodiversity conservation and the future of travel.

programme.title: Eco Africa
programme.desc: Eco Africa highlights the innovative and inspiring projects from across Africa and Europe that are being put into practice in a a bid to tackle climate change and support our depleting environments. In Africa especially, huge numbers of animal and wildlife species have dramatically fallen, largely due to a vast increase in human population across the continent. The increasing population is taking over vast swathes of natural land and in turn, adding to the demand for natural resources. This series explores the different concepts being used to help sustain our future, such as alternative resources, biodiversity conservation and the future of travel.

programme.title: Eco Africa
programme.desc: Eco Africa highlights the innovative and inspiring projects from across Africa and Europe that are being put into practice in a a bid to tackle climate change and support our depleting environments. In Africa especially, huge numbers of animal and wildlife species have dramatically fallen, largely due to a vast increase in human population across the continent. The increasing population is taking over vast swathes of natural land and in turn, adding to the demand for natural resources. This series explores the different concepts being used to help sustain our future, such as alternative resources, biodiversity conservation and the future of travel.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Hunting Adventures
programme.desc: If it's an animal roaming the wild, Jim Shockey has probably hunted it. The veteran wilderness guide and outfitter has tracked game in more than 40 countries and taken in excess of 300 species using bow, muzzleloader and rifle. In addition, Shockey has exclusive guiding territories on Vancouver Island, in the Yukon Territory, in Mexico's Sonoran Desert, and in his native Saskatchewan, all of which helps supply content for the hunting adventures seen in this award-winning series. Jim's daughter Eva, a full-fledged hunter in her own right, joins her dad on many episodes.

programme.title: Dirt Trax TV
programme.desc: "Dirt Trax Television" is an award-winning motor-sports production serving the demands of ATV and UTV enthusiasts across North America. Hosted by Luke and AJ Lester, it features in-depth reviews of the latest ATVs and side-by-side off-road vehicles, in-shop technical upgrades and maintenance features, instruction on responsible riding practices, destination guides, and human interest stories that capture the sport's adventurous spirit.

programme.title: Bow Madness
programme.desc: Some of the world's best bowhunters are featured on "Bow Madness," where the action is furious but the thinking quite clear: archery-only, adrenaline-always. The hunts across North America are led by Mark and Terry Drury, whose love for the sport and the outdoors led to the merchandising company Drury Outdoors in 1989 and a second career in television. In addition to chasing trophy whitetail or elusive wild turkey on "Bow Madness," the Drurys also star in "Dream Season," "King of the Spring," "Winchester & Drury's Natural Born" and "Wildlife Obsession" on Outdoor Channel.

programme.title: Canada in the Rough
programme.desc: The beautiful outdoors of Canada, from the majestic mountains of British Columbia to the mysterious bogs of Newfoundland, stars in this long-running and award-winning series. It's presented since 2010 by a combination of the Beasley brothers -- Paul, Keith and Kevin -- joined by special guests for adrenaline-pumping hunting adventures across the Great White North, which boasts more than 3 million square miles of rich wilderness. "Canada in the Rough" creator and original host Thomas Pigeon built the series into the country's most-watched hunting adventure show.
